newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to re-auction Mata oil contract Aug 20.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to re-auction Mata oil contract Aug 20.

text.p: Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will re-offer the contract to operate its Mata oilfield on August 20, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
Local companies Pivensa and PBE Trading Company were stripped of the contract they won at auction in June with a $90 million bid after PBE was bought out by another company.
The Mata field currently produces 600 barrels per day and has proven reserves of 101 million barrels.
The winning consortium will receive a percentage of the profits from any production rise from the field and is also allowed to explore for new reserves near the existing field.
The PBE/Pivensa offer beat by just three million dollars the second highest bid from Argentina's Perez Companc and Venezuela's Corporacion Corepli.
PDVSA has set a $85 billion base price this time.

The contract is reserved for a Venezuelan operator with a minimum 30 percent stake in the winning consortium. It was one of 20 areas originally offered to private companies in June under Venezuela's oil "apertura", or opening.
PBE Trading has been barred from the new auction, although Pivensa may participate.
